info.name: QAssure — Reporting & Analytics Service
info.description:
All 27 Report Service endpoints verified against live system on 28-Feb-2026.

Base URL: http://localhost:3000/api/v1

Auth: Supports THREE authentication modes:
(a) JWT only — QAssure UI users via Authorization: Bearer header
(b) JWT + API Key combined — Module on behalf of user (after SSO launch). JWT from verify-launch-token + X-API-Key. User permissions enforced. Audit trail shows real user.
(c) API Key + X-Tenant-ID — Module system/cron operations. Full module-level access. No user context.

Tenant: Pharma Corp (c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001)

Endpoints covered:
- Dashboard (1): GET /reporting/dashboard
- KPIs (1): GET /reporting/kpis
- Trends (1): GET /reporting/trends
- Reports (3): list, get, execute
- Search (3): global search, health, reindex
- Audit Logs (1): GET /reporting/audit-logs
- Scheduled Reports (6): CRUD + run + delete
- Exports (7): PDF/Excel for reports + dashboard, list, download, delete, cleanup
- Security (2): no auth, invalid JWT
- Auth modes (2): API Key only, Combined

Architecture notes:
- Export files are tenant-isolated: exports/{tenant_id}/
- All exports tracked in report_history with output_path
- Scheduled report execution generates export files (PDF/Excel)
- Daily cleanup cron purges files >30 days
- Cleanup admin endpoint: DELETE /exports/cleanup

item.name: 🔗 SSO Launch + Combined Auth
Step 1 — Login (get user JWT for launch)

request.description:
Login as tenant user. This simulates the QAssure UI login before module launch.
Token auto-saved to jwt_token variable.

Launch COC module for current user. Returns launch_url with token parameter.
Uses jwt_token from Step 1 (collection-level Bearer auth).
Launch token is a one-time token valid for ~60 seconds.

item.name: Step 3 — Verify Launch Token (get module JWT)

request.description:
Module backend exchanges launch token for session JWT.
⚠️ Uses coc_api_key (NOT api_key)
⚠️ Field name is 'token' (NOT 'launch_token')
⚠️ X-Tenant-ID is NOT needed — tenant derived from launch token

Response includes: user, tenant, access, permissions, module, token (24h expiry)

Run Step 2 immediately before this — launch tokens expire in ~60 seconds.

item.description:
Complete SSO launch flow for module developers (LTTS).

Flow: Login → Launch Module → Verify Launch Token (gets JWT) → Use JWT + API Key for all platform calls.

This is the RECOMMENDED mode for all user-context operations.
✅ Audit trail records real user identity
✅ User permissions enforced
✅ Module identity tracked for source attribution
⚠️ Uses coc_api_key variable (NOT api_key)
⚠️ X-Tenant-ID is NOT needed — tenant derived from JWT

Run Steps 1-3 first to set up module_jwt, then run any endpoint.
